title: Heliacal 8/8: event drivers + Ephemeris::heliacal_ut (arc completion)
description:
### Summary
Port the top-level heliacal event drivers — both search strategies (default vis_lim path and AVKIND arc_vis path) — and the public `swe_heliacal_ut` → `Ephemeris::heliacal_ut`. Completes the heliacal arc (Phase 13).

Read docs/codebase-map.md first. Do NOT read ../swisseph C source — docs/c-ref-heliacal-search.md is the source of truth.

### Files
- `src/heliacal.rs` — drivers + `pub fn heliacal_ut(...)` + `HeliacalEvent` output struct.
- `src/context.rs` — `Ephemeris::heliacal_ut` delegate.
- `src/lib.rs` — re-export `HeliacalEvent`.
- `tests/c-gen/gen_heliacal.c` — extend with `"events"` key; regenerate heliacal.json.
- `tests/golden/heliacal.rs` — extend.
- `docs/codebase-map.md` — full heliacal module entry (arc complete).

### Implementation steps
1. vis_lim-path drivers per search doc §5: `heliacal_ut_vis_lim` (zero-fills all output slots up front, synodic-period stepping with MAX_COUNT_SYNPER=5 — note §8: the C comment says 10 but the literal is 5 — LONG_SEARCH multiplier, conjunction anchoring via 7/8's find_conjunct_sun/get_asc_obl_with_sun, day search via get_heliacal_day, details via get_heliacal_details), `moon_event_vis_lim` (new-moon anchoring via `eph.pheno_ut` per §5's walkthrough), `MoonEventJDut`.
2. arc_vis-path drivers per §6: `heliacal_ut_arc_vis`, `moon_event_arc_vis`, `HeliacalJDut` — selected by HeliacalFlags::AVKIND bits. Port §6's quirks LITERALLY for golden parity: (a) this path populates only dret[0], leaving [1]/[2] as-is — since our vis_lim path zero-fills, they come out 0.0; (b) the final sanity-bound branch assigns the STALE loop variable (`dret[0] = JDNDaysUT`, not JDNDaysUTinp) — §6/§8 flag it as a likely C bug; reproduce it, with a code comment citing the ref doc; (c) the HeliacalAngle calls always pass AltM=-1, AziM=0 (Moon interference never actually factored — §8). The `#if 0` swe_heliacal_pheno_ut overwrite block is dead — skip.
3. Top-level dispatch per §7: `heliacal_ut` internal + `pub fn heliacal_ut(eph, tjd_start_ut, dgeo, datm, dobs, object_name: &str, event: HeliacalEventType, epheflag: CalcFlags, helflag: HeliacalFlags) -> Result<HeliacalEvent, Error>` — TypeEvent validation, object-class routing (Sun/Moon rejection rules, planet vs star, the acronychal-event routing §7 describes — note §8: swephexp.h's "not implemented" comment on acronychal is stale, they ARE handled), flag preprocessing, dret contract. `HeliacalEvent { start_visible: f64, optimum_visibility: f64, end_visible: f64 }` (dret[0..2]).
4. Delegate in context.rs; lib.rs re-export.
5. Extend gen_heliacal.c `"events"` key (~14 cases, record retval + dret[0..2]):
   - "sirius" TypeEvent=1 (heliacal rising) from 2453552.5 (2005-07-01) at Cairo [31.25,30.1,30.0] — the historically significant case;
   - "venus" TypeEvent=1 from 2453391.0 and TypeEvent=2 from 2453000.0, Cairo;
   - "venus" TypeEvent=3 and 4 from 2453100.0, Cairo (evening-first/morning-last synodic branches);
   - "moon" TypeEvent=3 (first crescent) from 2453461.5 (just after 2005-04-08 new moon) and one more lunation (2453491.0), Mecca [39.83,21.42,300.0];
   - "sirius" TypeEvent=2 from 2453450.0, Athens [23.7,38.0,100.0];
   - one LONG_SEARCH variant (venus TypeEvent=1 from a start ~2 synodic periods before the event);
   - two AVKIND_VR arc_vis cases (venus TypeEvent=1/2, same starts as above);
   - one HIGH_PRECISION variant of the Sirius rising.
   All SEFLG_SWIEPH; datm [1013.25,15,40,40], dobs [36,1,0,0,0,0]; ephe path + star buffers per gen_eclipse.c.
6. Regenerate heliacal.json; extend tests/golden/heliacal.rs: dret times eps 2e-5 day for vis_lim cases; arc_vis cases eps 1e-4 day (coarser search); retval exact. If a case's C retval is an error (e.g. −2 not-found within search window), assert the corresponding Err/None outcome.
7. Rewrite docs/codebase-map.md's heliacal entry as the full module summary (mark arc complete, list public API + quirks preserved).

### C reference
docs/c-ref-heliacal-search.md §5–§8 (call contracts into §1–§4 from 7/8, vision §10 HeliacalAngle, pheno doc for moon_event's pheno_ut usage).

### Golden tests
- Same gen_heliacal build/run as 4/8–6/8.
- `cargo test --test golden heliacal -- --nocapture`.

### Acceptance criteria
- `cargo test --test golden heliacal -- --nocapture` passes (all keys incl. 4/8–6/8 after regeneration).
- `cargo test` full suite green; no new clippy warnings.
- docs/codebase-map.md heliacal entry updated.

### Escape hatch
If event times diverge by > 1e-3 day (≈86 s) after two debugging attempts, STOP and report: failing cases, actual vs expected dret values, and at which layer the divergence first appears (compare intermediate get_heliacal_day/find_conjunct_sun values against the internals battery). A day-level (≥1.0) divergence usually means a branch went the other way in the synodic stepping — report the branch, don't grind. Escalate to Opus.
execution_record: Implemented in 3 commits: (1) event drivers + Ephemeris::heliacal_ut (vis_lim + arc_vis paths, HeliacalEvent struct, dispatch logic), (2) golden tests + topo_config fix (12 C-generated event cases at Cairo/Mecca/Athens observers, topo threading via calc_with_config in arc_vis path, TOPOCTR stripped from moon pheno_ut flags), (3) codebase-map update marking arc complete. Key surprise: arc_vis path's swe_calc calls with TOPOCTR failed because C relies on global swe_set_topo state — fixed by threading topo_config through calc_with_config/fixstar2_with_config. moon_event_arc_vis pheno_ut call stripped TOPOCTR (phase angle is geocentric)."

messages.text:
Codex review: approve with notes (2 high findings fixed in 22b05ef).

(1) CError conflated retryable/fatal errors — fixed via is_retryable() classifier + tjdmax guard on inner retry loop.
(2) AVKIND_VR iteration cap produced JD 0.0 instead of Err — fixed with explicit tb_vr==0 guard.
